provenance: Preparation protocol is prior art: arXiv:2302.01917 (Iqbal et al., Quantinuum H1) and Quantinuum tutorial 'Topological Order from Measurements and Feed-Forward' implement the same 4x4 Wen-plaquette preparation (16 data + 4 ancilla qubits, two X-measurement rounds, 7-entry LUT, conditional Z). This package contributes the pytket CustomPass integration, independent verification, regression tests, and reproducible benchmarking.

claims.evidence: prior art arXiv:2302.01917 + Quantinuum tutorial; contribution is compiler integration + verification + tests + benchmarking

claims.evidence: tests/test_compiler_pass.py (9 tests); full pytest suite passes
